0x4AC7.name: PACK_FUSE
0x4AC7.desc: Source of voltage to check for Min Blow Fuse Voltage

0x4AC7.name: SLEEPCHG
values: 1 = CHG FET remains on during sleep.
0 = CHG FET remains off during sleep (default).

0x4AC7.name: CHGFET
0x4AC7.desc: FET action on setting of GaugingStatus()[TC]
values: 1 = Charging and Precharging disabled, FET off

0x4AC7.name: CHGIN
0x4AC7.desc: FET action in CHARGE INHIBIT mode
values: 1 = Charging and precharging disabled, FETs off

0x4AC7.name: CHGSU
0x4AC7.desc: FET action in CHARGE SUSPEND mode
values: 1 = Charging and precharging disabled, FETs off

0x4AC7.name: OTFET
values: 1 = CHG and DSG FETs will be turned off for overtemperature conditions
0 = No FET action for overtemperature condition (default)

0x4AC7.name: PARALLEL_FETS
0x4AC7.desc: Series or Parallel circuit configuration for FETs

0x4AC9.name: RSOC_RND_OFF
0x4AC9.desc: Enables a round-off option of RSOC (instead of a ceiling function available by default)
values: 0 = Disables RSOC round-off (A ceiling function is used instead.)

0x4AC9.name: LOCK0
0x4AC9.desc: Keep RemainingCapacity() and RelativeStateOfCharge() jumping back during relaxation after 0 was reached during discharge

0x4AC9.name: RSOC_HOLD
0x4AC9.desc: Prevent RSOC from increasing during discharge
values: 1 = RSOC not allowed to increase during discharge

0x4AC9.name: RSOCL
0x4AC9.desc: RelativeStateOfCharge() and RemainingCapacity() behavior at end of charge
values: 1 = Held at 99% until valid charge termination. On entering valid charge termination update to 100%

0x4ACA.name: FLASH_BUSY_WAIT
0x4ACA.desc: This allows the clock stretching during a flash program or erase operation
values: 1 = The BQ40Z80 device will clock stretch (up to the timeout for SMBus devices) during flash operations.

0 = The BQ40Z80 device will NACK any SMBus engine interrupt that occurs during a flash operation (program or erase). Note: There is some potential for read errors with this bit. For example, when the master is reading data from the device, there is no NACK from the gauge; therefore, the "NACK" in the hardware releases the bus without writing new data to the SMBDA register, which means the read is whatever is present at the time. PECs should catch this error.

0x4ACA.name: SMB_CELL_TEMP
0x4ACA.desc: Enables the host to write the temperature register via MAC command WriteTemp(). This enables bypassing the gauge’s cell temperature inputs (TS1...TS4)
values: 1 = Host can set the temperature (and bypass TS1...TS4).
0 = Host cannot set the temperature (temperature is set by the gauge's thermistors).

0x4ACA.name: BCAST
0x4ACA.desc: Enables alert and charging broadcast from device to host

0x4ACB.name: SHA1_SECURE
0x4ACB.desc: Enables secure memory usage for encryption key storage

0x4ACB.name: SPLIT_RESPONSE
0x4ACB.desc: 42 bytes ECC response is returned in a single block or 2 blocks
values: 1 = Response is split into two blocks: first block is 31 bytes and second block is 11 bytes.
0 = Response is single block of 42 bytes.

0x4ACB.name: LEGACY_SHA1
0x4ACB.desc: ECC or SHA-1 authentication is enabled

0x4ACC.name: SLEEPWKCHG
0x4ACC.desc: Enables the sleep wake charge feature

0x4ACC.name: SLP_ACCUM
0x4ACC.desc: Enables charge accumulation while in SLEEP mode
values: 1 = Enables charge accumulation in SLEEP mode
0 = Disables charge accumulation in SLEEP mode

0x4ACC.name: CHECK_WAKE_FET
0x4ACC.desc: Enables the CHG and DSG FETs not to be forced off during the Delay timer period
values: 1 = FETs are not to be forced off during the Delay timer period.
0 = FETs are forced off during the Delay timer period.

0x4ACC.name: CHECK_WAKE
0x4ACC.desc: Enables option to manage unintended wakeup from SHUTDOWN
values: 1 = Enables this option for unintended wakeup
0 = Disables this option for unintended wakeup

0x4ACC.name: EMSHUT_EXIT_COMM
0x4ACC.desc: Enables exit from Emergency FET shutdown if valid SMBus communication is received. Valid SMBus communication means a valid gauge address and any command is received (that is, an invalid command with a valid address is OK)
values: 1 = Enables valid communication reception based exit from EMSHUT
0 = Disables valid communication reception based exit from EMSHUT

0x4ACC.name: EMSHUT_EXIT_VPACK
0x4ACC.desc: Enables exit from Emergency FET shutdown if voltage at PACK pin > Charger Present Threshold for two samples (~2 seconds)
values: 1 = Enables PACK voltage based exit from EMSHUT
0 = Disables PACK voltage based exit from EMSHUT

0x4ACC.name: PWR_SAVE_VSHUT
0x4ACC.desc: Enables POWER SAVE SHUTDOWN when specific thresholds have been reached

0x4ACC.name: AUTO_SHIP_EN
values: 1 = Enables auto shutdown after the device is in SLEEP mode without communication for a set period of time.

0x4ACE.name: BTP_POL
0x4ACE.desc: Controls polarity of the BTP pin
values: 1 = The BTP pin is asserted high when BTP is triggered.
0 = The BTP pin is asserted low when BTP is triggered (default).

0x4ACE.name: BTP_EN
0x4ACE.desc: Enables assertion of the BTP pin
values: 1 = Enables assertion of the BTP pin when BTP is triggered.
0 = Disables assertion of the BTP pin when BTP is triggered (default).

0x4B0C.name: LEDONFC
0x4B0C.desc: Enables the LED display to stay on showing charge even after full charge (FC) has been achieved. With this bit set, the LED will stay on after FC until the LED FC time has expired
values: 1 = Enables LED display functionality after FC until the LED FC time has expired
0 = Disables LED display functionality after FC until the LED FC time has expired

0x4B0C.name: BLINKMIDPT
0x4B0C.desc: Enables LED blinking until the midpoint of each LED segment. The blinking occurs between the bottom and the midway point of each programmed segment level, thus providing more granularity as to where the charge level is within that LED segment
values: 1 = Enables LED blinking until the midway point of each segment charge levels
0 = Disables LED blinking until the midway point of each segment charge levels

0x4B0C.name: LEDIFCUV
0x4B0C.desc: Enables LED display functionality even under CUV conditions without a charger connected (no charging occurring). This option should be used with care so as to not discharge the battery to low
values: 1 = Enables LED display functionality even under CUV conditions without a charger connected
0 = Disables LED display functionality even under CUV conditions without a charger connected

0x4B0C.name: LEDPFON
values: 0 = Display not available in PF mode (default) LEDC1, LEDC0 (Bit 7, Bit 6): LED current sink 0, 0 = 0.94 mA average LED current (default) 0, 1 = 1.87 mA average LED current 1, 0 = 2.81 mA average LED current 1, 1 = 3.75 mA average LED current LEDPF1, LEDPF0 (Bit 5, Bit 4): LED display PF error code 0, 0 = PF Error Code not available 0, 1 = PF Error Code shown after SOC if DISP is held low for LED hold time (default). 1, 0 = PF Error code shown if the DISP button is pressed (high-to-low transition of the pin is detected). 1, 1 = PF Error Code shown after SOC

0x4B0C.name: LEDRCA
0x4B0C.desc: Flashing of LED display when [RCA] is set

0x4B0C.name: LEDR
0x4B0C.desc: LED display activation at exit of device reset

0x4B71.name: TCSETVCT
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TC flag set by primary charge termination

0x4B71.name: FCSETVCT
0x4B71.desc: Enables the FC flag set by primary charge termination

0x4B71.name: TCCLEARRSOC
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TC flag clear by RSOC threshold

0x4B71.name: TCSETRSOC
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TC flag set by RSOC threshold

0x4B71.name: TCCLEARV
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TC flag clear by cell voltage threshold

0x4B71.name: TCSETV
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TC flag set by cell voltage threshold

0x4B71.name: TDCLEARRSOC
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TD flag clear by RSOC threshold

0x4B71.name: TDSETRSOC
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TD flag set by RSOC threshold

0x4B71.name: TDCLEARV
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TD flag clear by cell voltage threshold

0x4B71.name: TDSETV
0x4B71.desc: Enables the TD flag set by cell voltage threshold

0x4B73.name: FCCLEARRSOC
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FC flag clear by RSOC threshold

0x4B73.name: FCSETRSOC
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FC flag set by RSOC threshold

0x4B73.name: FCCLEARV
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FC flag clear by cell voltage threshold

0x4B73.name: FCSETV
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FC flag set by cell voltage threshold

0x4B73.name: FDCLEARRSOC
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FD flag clear by RSOC threshold
values: 0 = Disabled FDSETRSOC Bit 2: Enables the FD flag set by RSOC threshold

0x4B73.name: FDCLEARV
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FD flag clear by cell voltage threshold

0x4B73.name: FDSETV
0x4B73.desc: Enables the FD flag set by cell voltage threshold

0x4B9D.name: DOD_RSCALE_EN
0x4B9D.desc: Configures which DOD the new RScale is to be applied
values: 1 = The RScale is only applied to DODs higher than the DOD where the RScale was calculated.
0 = The RScale is applied to all DODs during IT simulations.

0x4B9D.name: TDELTAV
values: 1 = Calculate DeltaVoltage that corresponds to the power spike defined in Min Turbo Power. Must set this flag to 1 to support TURBO mode.
0 = Use of DeltaVoltage learned as the maximal difference between instantaneous and average voltage (default).

0x4B9D.name: SMOOTH
values: 1 = Smoothed FullChargeCapacity() and RemainingCapacity() is used (default).
0 = True FullChargeCapacity() and RemainingCapacity() is used.

0x4B9D.name: RELAX_JUMP_OK
0x4B9D.desc: Allows RSOC jump during RELAX mode

0x4B9D.name: CSYNC
0x4B9D.desc: Sync RemainingCapacity() with FullChargeCapacity() at valid charge termination

0x4BA1.name: TS1/TS0
0x4BA1.desc: These two bits are used in conjunction to select which one of the individual temperature sensors (TS 1…4) is used by the IT algorithm
values: 1,0 = Min Temperature is used (IT uses the temperature sensor with the lowest temperature).
0,1 = Avg Temperature is used (IT uses the average temperature of all 4 temperature sensors).
0,0 = Max Temperature is used (IT uses the temperature sensor with the highest temperature). (Default)

0x4BA1.name: CELL_INTER_IR
0x4BA1.desc: Enables the cell interconnect resistance to be used to compensate the cell voltage when cell-based EDV detection is selected (Vs Pack based EDV detection)
values: 1 = Enables cell interconnect resistance usage to compensate cell voltage in relation to cell EDV detection
0 = Disables cell interconnect resistance usage to compensate cell voltage in relation to cell EDV detection

0x4BA1.name: THERM_SAT
0x4BA1.desc: Thermal saturation enables adjustment of the IT thermal model
values: 1 = Enables adjustment of the IT thermal model
0 = Disables adjustment of the IT thermal model

0x4BA1.name: THERM_IV
0x4BA1.desc: Enables the freeze of the temperature model at certain points in IT to prevent overestimation by the thermal model
values: 1 = Enables the freeze of the temperature model
0 = Disables the freeze of the temperature model

0x4BA1.name: AMB_PRED
0x4BA1.desc: Enables ambient temperature prediction in modes other than RELAX

0x4BA1.name: CHG_100_SMOOTH_OK
0x4BA1.desc: Allows smoothing in the charge direction when there is a jump to 100%

0x4BA1.name: DSG_0_SMOOTH_OK
0x4BA1.desc: Allows smoothing in the discharge direction when there is a jump to 0%. When enabled, this smoothing option must be used in conjunction with Term Smooth Start Cell V Delta, Term Smooth Time, and Term Smooth Final Cell V Delta. If

0x4C90.name: CYCLE_DEGRADE
0x4C90.desc: Cycle count based charging current or charging voltage degradation
values: 1 = Degradation CC/CV based on cycle count
0 = No degradation of CC/CV based on cycle count

0x4C90.name: SOH_DEGRADE
0x4C90.desc: SOH based charging current or charging voltage degradation
values: 0 = No degradation of CC/CV based on SOH

0x4C90.name: DEGRADE_CC
0x4C90.desc: Enables charging current degradation based on cycle count or SOH

0x4C90.name: COMP_IR
0x4C90.desc: Allows IR compensation at the system level to ensure the correct voltage level required for a specific charging voltage at the battery terminals

0x4C90.name: CS_CV
0x4C90.desc: This enables the cell swelling control under specific cell voltage and cell temperature thresholds by reducing the charging voltage

0x4C90.name: SOC_CHARGE
values: 1 = Enables SOC threshold to replace voltage thresholds (CLV, CMV, and CHV) in Advanced Charging Algorithm
0 = Uses voltage thresholds (CLV, CMV, and CHV) in Advanced Charging Algorithm

0x4C90.name: CRATE
values: 1 = ChargingCurrent() adjusted based on FullChargeCapacity() / DesignCapacity()

0x4D02.name: RSVD
values: 0 = Cell temperature (default) TS3 Mode (Bit 3): Cell temperature or FET temperature
0 = Cell temperature (default) TS2 Mode (Bit 2): Cell temperature or FET temperature
0 = Cell temperature TS1 Mode (Bit 1): Cell temperature or FET temperature
0 = Cell temperature (default) TSInt Mode (Bit 0): Cell temperature or FET temperature

0x4D03.name: CTEMP
0x4D03.desc: Defines which temperature sensor's output is displayed by the SBS Temperature() command 1, 1 = Not used 1, 0 = Minimum temperature 0, 1 = Average temperature 0, 0 = Maximum temperature

0x4D03.name: EMSHUT_PEXIT_DIS
0x4D03.desc: Disables the SHUTDN pin exit option of the emergency FET shutdown feature (when a high-to-low transition on the SHUTDN pin is detected)
values: 1 = Prevents usage of SHUTDN pin as exit option
0 = Allows usage of SHUTDN pin as an exit option (default)

0x4B8C.name: CB_RLX_DOD0EW
values: 1 = Enables Error Weighted DOD0 for cell balancing time updates when in RELAX mode
0 = Uses DOD0 for cell balancing time updates when in RELAX mode

0x4B8C.name: CB_CHG_DOD0EW
values: 1 = Enables error weighted DOD0 for cell balancing time updates when in CHARGE mode
0 = Uses DOD0 for cell balancing time updates when in CHARGE mode

0x4BBD.name: CUDEP_REQ_CHG
0x4BBD.desc: Forces the charge request to be non-zero during copper deposition check for PFStatus()[CUV]

0x4BBD.name: CUV_RECOV_CHG
0x4BBD.desc: Requires the charge to recover SafetyStatus()[CUV]

0x4BBE.name: RSVD_ONE
0x4BBE.desc: Reserved and programmed to 1. Do not use

0x4BBF.name: RSVD_ONE
0x4BBF.desc: Reserved and programmed to 1. Do not use

0x4BBF.name: ASCC
values: 0 = Disables the SafetyAlert() and SafetyStatus() flag only and does NOT disable the FET actions.

0x4BC1.name: PCHGC
0x4BC1.desc: ChargingCurrent() higher than requested in precharge

0x4C47.name: PTC
values: 1 = Enables PFStatus[PTC] = 1 when PTC fault is triggered. The function should be enabled/disabled by the PTCEN pin connection.
0 = Disables the PFStatus[PTC] = 1 when PTC fault is triggered. The function should be enabled/disabled by the PTCEN pin connection.

0x4C47.name: 2LVL
0x4C47.desc: FUSE input indicating fuse trigger by external 2nd level protection

0x4D07.name: RSTRIM
0x4D07.desc: Unsupport function. Should leave the default setting 0x7. Changing this setting may cause an error to the AFE current protection accuracy

0x44D8.name: Enable
0x44D8.desc: Impedance Track gauging and lifetime updating enable
values: 0,0 = Impedance Track gauging and lifetime updating is disabled.
1,0 = QMax and Ra table have been updated.

0x4B2A.name: CHGM
values: 1 = Disables ChargingVoltage() and ChargingCurrent() broadcasts to the host and smart battery charger (default)
0 = Enables ChargingVoltage() and ChargingCurrent() broadcasts to the host and smart battery charger

0x4B2A.name: AM
values: 1 = Disables AlarmWarning() broadcasts to host and smart battery charger
0 = Enables AlarmWarning() broadcasts to host and smart battery charger (default)

0x4B2A.name: PB
values: 1 = Battery operating in its primary role
0 = Battery operating in its secondary role (default)

0x4B2C.name: IPScale
values: 0,0,0,0 = Reported currents and capacities scaled by 10E0 except ChargingVoltage() and ChargingCurrent()
0,0,0,1 = Reported currents and capacities scaled by 10E1 except ChargingVoltage() and ChargingCurrent()
